posts.content_md: Not sure why I thought of this and I have not seen any research on it and it may be completely wrong. But.... How about if a small electrical DC charge is placed thoughout the DCG emulsion to create a higher potential for the hydrogen to break its bond with oxygen (water in the emulsion). I was thinking of using the conductive electroforming tape. Thus the hydrogen would be more easily available for crosslinking. It may increase speed. It may also allow DCG to be used with pulsed lasers. Well, any comments? Or is it as far fetched as my color control with a vacuum idea?
